system.description: A doting, grandfatherly god of despair, disease and decay who treats rot as one more form of life and urges kindness in life's short span.
system.summary: A doting, grandfatherly god of despair, disease and decay who treats rot as one more form of life and urges kindness in life's short span.
commandments: Do not ask for aid; rise or fall by your own persistence.
Faith is the only way out of suffering.
Comfort the dying even though they cannot be saved.
directives: Celebrate and protect life, which is beautiful.
Grow and be glad, for growth expresses life.
Respect natural cycles; fleeing them means leaving his embrace.
Accept decay so that others get their chance to live.
Do not mourn death; it closes one chapter and opens another.

cults.name: Vectors
cults.summary: Heirs of a plague-carrying founder who knowingly spread disease under Nurgle's protection, some personally tending the victims they infected.

cults.name: Hospitallers
cults.summary: Cheerful hospices under Nurgle's patronage that comfort the incurable, where remission or symptom-free carriers are common though cures are rare.
